title: Slow Cooked American Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and comforting slow-cooked stew made with tender chicken and a variety of vegetables in a rich and flavorful broth.

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the diced onion and celery to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet contents to the slow cooker. Add the chicken broth and water to the slow cooker.
Return the chicken to the slow cooker and cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours.
Check the chicken for tenderness. If necessary, cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
